# Permission

The Mountain Railway Diorama is MIT-licensed (see `LICENSE`). Beyond the
licence, the author gave explicit public permission for it to be shown in
Whistlevale.

- **Author:** Techartist — [@techartist_](https://x.com/techartist_) on X,
  [iamtechartist](https://github.com/iamtechartist) on GitHub
- **Upstream:** https://github.com/iamtechartist/mountain-railway-diorama
- **Commit vendored here:** see `UPSTREAM-COMMIT.txt`
- **Permission given:** publicly on X, 11 September 2026, in reply to a request
  to add the project to Whistlevale with credit. The author asked for
  attribution, which the guest room carries on its credit dock, its plaque and
  its map card.

The source in this directory is unmodified. Changes needed to run it in the
house belong in `src/guest-yamaai.js`, which is house code, so that this
directory stays a faithful copy of the author's work.
